mapper.sql: SELECT bs.streamer_id, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.avg_viewers)), 0)::int AS avg_viewers, COALESCE(MAX(r.peak_viewers), 0) AS peak_viewers, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_chat), 0)::bigint AS total_chat, COUNT(*) AS total_broadcast_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE bs.started_at >= now() - INTERVAL '28 days') / 4.0)::int AS broadcasts_per_week FROM broadcast_sessions bs LEFT JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = bs.id AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') WHERE bs.status = 'ENDED'
mapper.update:
UPDATE portfolios p SET avg_viewers = m.avg_viewers, peak_viewers = m.peak_viewers, total_chat = m.total_chat, total_broadcast_count = m.total_broadcast_count, broadcasts_per_week = m.broadcasts_per_week FROM (
AND bs.streamer_id = #{streamerId} GROUP BY bs.streamer_id ) m WHERE p.streamer_id = m.streamer_id

UPDATE portfolios p SET avg_viewers = m.avg_viewers, peak_viewers = m.peak_viewers, total_chat = m.total_chat, total_broadcast_count = m.total_broadcast_count, broadcasts_per_week = m.broadcasts_per_week FROM (
GROUP BY bs.streamer_id ) m WHERE p.streamer_id = m.streamer_id
